BiblicalUsage: Zebidah is the mother of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, named in the single verse that introduces his reign. The Hebrew is written one way and read another: the written form is Zebidah and the spoken form, which the King James follows, is Zebudah, daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mother's name in a king's record is no small thing, because Jehoiakim's reign is measured against the kings before him and his mother's house is part of the account.
RelatedPeople: Zebudah, Mother of Jehoiakim; Jehoiakim, King of Judah
